items.description: Standings for GW[1, 2]: records, points, and streaks are exact (rebuilt from final match results). League rank isn't shown for those gameweeks — when two managers are tied, we don't yet know for certain how FPL breaks the tie that early in the season, so rank is left blank rather than guessed. It'll fill in once a real tie in a later gameweek lets us confirm the rule.
